authorization.user_message: 现在的速度基本山够用了，不用得追求8,现在重点应该是提高一下整体的成功率，包括最终的RL的
authorization.interpretation: Use the existing 5 m/s criterion as the primary task speed requirement and optimize complete-episode reliability, including the final RL policy. Do not require 8 m/s for task success.

historical_speed8_metric: Archived secondary comparison; not the current task pass criterion or optimization target.

evaluation_reporting.changing_policy_rollouts: Development observations only; do not present as frozen-policy performance.
evaluation_reporting.teacher_or_control_assisted_policy: Report its assistance mode and measured complete success separately.
evaluation_reporting.final_rl_policy: Require frozen-policy physical evaluation without teacher actions completing the movement; retain the actual low-level servo and declared control limits.
evaluation_reporting.formal_panels: Use the existing complete A/B panels and the worse panel for each retained reliability threshold. No panel has passed under this revision.

implementation.existing_field_alias: curriculum_complete5 is the already-computed legacy field for the new primary complete5 event chain; preserve original files and label provenance.
implementation.running_and_queued_native_inputs: Unchanged; rescore their actual episode evidence under this versioned primary metric.
implementation.ground64_branch: Remains a declared diagnostic physical branch; this speed revision does not silently promote its ground geometry to formal acceptance.
